dialogues.speaker: Mawyo
dialogues.text: I'm a "freelancer." Just call me Mawyo.

dialogues.speaker: Mawyo
dialogues.text: Dad's been rattling a lot about what I'm doing, but I don't care. The benefits of being a freelancer are something those old fogeys like my dad and my brother wouldn't understand.

dialogues.speaker: Mawyo
dialogues.text: What to do, when to start, how much to earn... I call the shots. Isn't it amazing?
